metadata.title: How Many Coins Are in a Roll? — Coin Roll Quantities & Values

description: How many coins are in a roll? A roll of pennies is 50 ($0.50), nickels 40 ($2), dimes 50 ($5), quarters 40 ($10), half dollars 20 ($10), dollar coins 25 ($25). Full table + a roll value calculator with live silver melt.
text:
How Many Coins Are in a Roll?
Standard US coin rolls hold a fixed number of coins: a roll of
dimes is 50
($5),
quarters 40
($10),
nickels 40
($2) and
pennies 50
($0.50).
Use the table and calculator below to count coins, total face value, and — for pre-1965 silver rolls —
the live silver melt value.

Quick answers
How many pennies are in a roll?
A standard roll of pennies contains 50 coins, with a face value of $0.50.
How many nickels are in a roll?
A standard roll of nickels contains 40 coins, with a face value of $2.00.
How many dimes are in a roll?
A standard roll of dimes contains 50 coins, with a face value of $5.00.
How many quarters are in a roll?
A standard roll of quarters contains 40 coins, with a face value of $10.00.
How many half dollars are in a roll?
A standard roll of half dollars contains 20 coins, with a face value of $10.00.
How many dollar coins are in a roll?
A standard roll of dollar coins contains 25 coins, with a face value of $25.00.
Rolls of
1964-or-earlier dimes, quarters and half dollars are 90% silver
and worth many
